authenticity_review: The image exhibits significant AI artifacts. The candles have a rough, pitted texture resembling porous rock or frozen slush rather than smooth wax, and lack visible wicks (flames emerge directly from wax). The motorcycle shows structural collapse in the rear wheel area, with spokes blending into the background. The sheep suffer from boundary fusion, appearing as a merged woolly mass rather than distinct animals, and lack anatomical definition (no clear legs or faces). The animal pose auditor reported 100% low-confidence keypoints for the sheep, confirming severe structural ambiguity.
